current_task.progress: PR #306 is production-complete. The fix removed the broad section descendant override and leaves section-level scale to `.sp-section-head h2`, card scale to `.sp-card h2` and step scale to `.sp-step h2`. All premerge security, standalone, V2 and visual regressions were green.
